_comment: Unit name -> base Battle Value (BV2). Keys are matched against card filenames after normalization (uppercase, punctuation/spaces removed), so 'Atlas AS7-D', 'ATLAS AS7D' and 'atlas-as7-d' all match the same entry. This starter set is small; load a full table via the 'Load BV table' button (CSV or JSON exported from the Master Unit List). Verify these example values against your own source.
